senses.gloss: ch. <cite ref="U00003">same</cite>.—Part. <cite ref="U00003"><he>שָׁאֵב</he></cite>, <cite ref="U00894"><he>שָׁיֵיב</he></cite>; f. <he>שָׁאֵיבָא</he>, <cite ref="U00006"><he>שָׁאֵיבְתָּא</he></cite>, <cite ref="U00894"><he>שָׁיְיבָא</he></cite>; pl. <he>שְׁאִיבֵי</he>, <he>שָׁיְיבֵי</he> &c.
units: <cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 20:2">Targ. I Chr. XX, 2</cite> <he>אבנא ש׳</he> = h. <he>אבן שׁוֹאֶבֶת</he>, v. <cite ref="A00172"><he>אֶבֶן</he></cite>; <cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 23:11">Targ. II Chr. XXIII, 11</cite> <he>אבן טבא ושייבא</he> (ed. Lag. only <he>אבן טבא</he>).—

<cite ref="Chullin 93b:6">Ḥull. 93ᵇ</cite> <he>מִשְׁאַב שְׁאִיבֵי ליה</he> they (the glowing coals) draw (the blood out of the veins), opp. <cite ref="R00602"><he>צְמַת</he></cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 74b:9">Pes. 74ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Yoma 69b:10">Yoma 69ᵇ</cite> <he>אברא משאב שאיב קלא</he> lead absorbs (deadens) the sound; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 64a">Snh. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>דשָׁיֵיב</he> ed. Sonc. (ed. <he>דשָׁיֵיף</he>; Ms. M. <he>דשאיף</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 70); a. fr.
